root_cause: The text-field pointer path had no long-press recognizer. A held primary press on an EditableText never reached Flutter's onSingleLongTapStart, so no word was selected.
change: crates/incular-runtime/src/frame/text_gestures.rs (LongPressTarget, TextLongPress, text_long_press_begin, pump_text_long_press, text_long_press_moved, text_long_press_move, text_long_press_end): a primary press on a field is recorded as a possible long press; the frame-clock deadline (LONG_PRESS_TIMEOUT, 500 ms) selects the word on Android, Fuchsia, Linux and Windows and places the caret on iOS and macOS when focused. Moves beyond TOUCH_SLOP cancel it; a started long press extends by word (text_field_select_words_in_range). A touch or stylus long press shows the context menu on release. crates/incular-runtime/src/frame.rs: new field text_long_press, the frame-clock hook beside pump_gesture_timers (its liveness keeps frames running until the deadline), and Down, Move, Up and Cancel branches.
harness: text__editable_long_press_word_selection: match (4 frames, after the fix; was [0,5] vs collapsed at 1)
limitations: Mouse presses also long-press, as in Flutter's TextSelectionGestureDetector, but the harness only drives touch. The iOS and macOS caret path is covered by one macOS test; the drag caret path is not separately tested. The toolbar anchors at the release position.
note: Long-press selection is gated by the same pointer-selection policy as taps (text_field_pointer_selection_enabled), so a read-only obscured field keeps focus but no long press.

root_cause: Selectable text had no long-press path, and SelectionAreaController exposed geometry and revision listeners but no selected-content callback. Flutter's SelectableRegion selects the word on a touch or stylus long press, extends it by word on move, and reports content through SelectionArea.onSelectionChanged. Separately, Incular joined selected labels with a newline, while Flutter's getSelectedContent concatenates them with no separator (selectable_region.dart:2826; paragraph.dart RenderParagraph.getSelectedContent).
change: crates/incular-runtime/src/frame/text_gestures.rs: selectable_text_select_word_at returns the selected range; a touch or stylus press on selectable text starts a long press (LongPressTarget::Label). crates/incular-runtime/src/frame.rs: touch-kind gate (_kLongPressSelectionDevices) on the Down path; the Move path extends by word through the anchor word while a long press is started. crates/incular-widgets/src/selection.rs: selection_changed slot on SelectionAreaState, set_selection_changed_listener and clear_selection_changed_listener, and the callback fired from set_selection_snapshot when the selected text changes (Option<SelectedContent>, None when empty). crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/text.rs (outside my ownership, small additions): selectable_text_affinity_position_at (the hit with its caret affinity, selectable_text_position_at delegates to it); selectable_text_select_words_to (word-granular extension from an anchor word, direction from element order); static_selection_text joins labels with no separator. crates/incular-material/src/inputs/text_fields.rs: SelectionArea::on_selection_changed. selectable_text_select_word_at uses the upstream affinity so a press on the space after a word selects that word.
tests: crates/incular-widgets/tests/selection_area_lifetime.rs (cross_element_drags_normalize_copy_order, keyed_reorder_keeps_selection_on_elements, removed_endpoint_degrades_without_panic_and_recovers, hidden_and_nested_content_follow_ownership: expectations changed from newline to no-separator joins)
harness: text__selection_area_long_press_drag: match (5 frames, after the fix; was selected_length 0 vs 5). Twin changes are listed in the .md file.
api_change: additive: SelectionAreaController::set_selection_changed_listener and clear_selection_changed_listener (widgets); SelectionArea::on_selection_changed (material). Behavior change: multi-label selected text is concatenated without newlines, matching Flutter; copy output changes accordingly.
limitations: Plain Text inside a SelectionArea is not selectable in Incular (only SelectableText registers as a selectable child). That is a separate gap, not fixed here. The selection callback fires on text changes only, as the harness requires; Flutter's null-content callback is passed as None. Mouse drag selection is not harnessed. The callback is stored on the controller and replaced on each build of the area, so one controller can serve one callback at a time.
note: Two unrelated failures remain in runtime.rs (semantic_callbacks_make_custom_controls_actionable, runtime_routes_identified_contacts_to_retained_scale_regions) and one in tree_editing_semantics_gestures.rs (gesture_region_combines_identified_contacts_for_scale_updates). They concern semantics and scale gestures, not text selection; not investigated.
